postTitle: Fee Optimization: The Silent Drag on Your Returns
topic: A 1% fee takes about a quarter of a 40 year pot

assumptions.notes: €10,000 start, €500 a month, 40 years, 7% nominal before fees, compounded monthly (blog model, corrected Oct 2026). Final pots: 0.05% fee €1,454,027; 0.5% €1,275,505; 1% €1,105,320; 1.5% €960,317. 1% vs 0.05%: €348,707 less, 24.0%. 1.5% vs 0.05%: €493,709, 34.0%. Before tax; returns not guaranteed.
